verdict.rationale: The official `ccloud` CLI is documented to create, manage, and connect to CockroachDB Cloud clusters, and `ccloud quickstart` creates a cluster interactively. For local work, the `cockroach` binary (installable via Homebrew) runs single-node or `cockroach demo` clusters that open an interactive SQL shell, so create, connect, and shell are covered without the dashboard. Missing for 10: explicit CLI evidence for inspecting databases or cluster status (beyond running SQL in the shell), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI-only workflow.
